title: Glutathione Cream for Dark Spots: What It Can and Can't Do
ex: A glutathione cream can help reduce the look of some dark spots over time. Learn which marks it suits, how to use it, and when to see a dermatologist.
rt: Glutathione Cream for Dark Spots: Guide | Mirc Glow
rd: Glutathione cream for dark spots: which marks it may help the look of, how to use it with sunscreen, a realistic timeline, and when melasma needs a doctor.
quick: A glutathione cream can help reduce the look of old pimple marks, tan and uneven tone over 8 to 12 weeks, especially when it also contains kojic acid and vitamin C. It needs daily sunscreen. Melasma or changing spots should be checked by a dermatologist.
facts: Research on glutathione applied to skin is still limited.
Kojic acid is usually about 1–2% in creams.
A more even look usually takes 8–12 weeks with daily sunscreen.
Melasma and spots that change, bleed or grow need a dermatologist.
